subject: Adding data labels to a stacked bar chart

messages.author: 5b2ee74e3edde3f9
messages.subject: Adding data labels to a stacked bar chart
parts:
Is there an easy way to determine the y position of data labels in a
stacked bar chart. A sample of my data set is:


SaleWeek DaysListed_Bucket Margin count
4 0 936.7657 2
5 0 822.5499 2
5 8 358.6596 1
6 0 781.2257 3
6 8 529.0567 3
6 16 262.3994 1

I'm using the following code:

p <- ggplot(data=d_bysaleweek, aes(x=factor(SaleWeek),
fill=factor(Day_FirstListedToReserved_Tranche), y=count))
p + geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity") +
geom_text(aes(label=Margin, y=count, x=factor(SaleWeek), size=3))

The problem is that the y positioning for the geom_text is wrong -
it's the count rather than the correct reading on the y axis. Does
anyone have any thoughts on the best way to get round this?

Many thanks,

Alan

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Adding data labels to a stacked bar chart
parts:
Hi Alan,

I think you want:

geom_text(aes(label=Margin, y=count), size=3, position = "stack")

This won't work in the currently released version, but it should work
in the next version which I'm on track to release tomorrow.

Hadley
